en-US.description:
IFCDC Barbers makes it easy to book professional barbershop appointments. Browse real haircut and style photos, choose your service, pick a barber and time, and pay securely with PayPal.

Features:
• Book appointments with live availability
• View service photos and style gallery before you book
• Secure PayPal checkout and email confirmations
• AURA assistant for quick booking help
• Manage your profile and booking history

Official app for IFCDC Barbers — smart booking powered by real style photos.
en-US.promoText: Book your next cut — browse styles, pick a barber, pay with PayPal.
en-US.title: IFCDC Barbers
en-US.subtitle: Book cuts with style photos
en-US.releaseNotes: Build 36 — App Store compliance: Sign in with Apple, in-app account deletion (Profile → Delete account), and updated photo library permission text.

review.notes:
Sign-in is required. Use the demo account credentials provided in App Review Information (email + password), or Sign in with Apple / Google on the login screen.

Account deletion (Guideline 5.1.1(v)): Profile tab → Delete account → type DELETE → confirm. Permanently removes the account and personal data.

Testing steps:
1. Open IFCDC Barbers and go to Profile → Sign In.
2. Enter the demo email and password exactly as supplied (or use Sign in with Apple).
3. Book tab → select barber → service → date/time → PayPal checkout.
4. AURA tab → ask about booking, services, or hours.
5. Browse service/style photos during the booking flow.

The demo account is a standard customer with full access to booking, profile, and AURA. No admin credentials are needed.
